Paragraph: "Stuart, a clergyman's son, related his experience of being out of his body. He said, ‘I was looking out of a window that opened onto a graveyard. It was dark as a grey blur, staring up at me. After I had floated the length and breadth of the building I descended quietly, of my own accord, and landed lightly on the spot from where I had been taken, whereupon I walked directly out of the building without looking back. As I walked swiftly away down a gravel path someone like Barbara came running towards me in a white coat, approaching from a thick hedge that surrounded the graveyard. "Quick", she said over her shoulder, 'don't let him get out!' But I walked straight into a wood that confronted me without a qualm.'""
